quotes.quote: Life is a culmination of the past, an awareness of the present, an indication of a future beyond knowledge, the quality that gives a touch of divinity to matter.
quotes.author: Charles Lindbergh

quotes.quote: Forgiving does not erase the bitter past. A healed memory is not a deleted memory. Instead, forgiving what we cannot forget creates a new way to remember. We change the memory of our past into a hope for our future.
quotes.author: Lewis B. Smedes

quotes.quote: The future is not Big Government. Self-serving politicians. Powerful bureaucrats. This has been tried, tested throughout history. The result has always been disaster. President Obama, your agenda is not new. It's not change, and it's not hope.
quotes.author: Rush Limbaugh

quotes.quote: Nobody can predict the future. You just have to give your all to the relationship you're in and do your best to take care of your partner, communicate and give them every last drop of love you have. I think one of the most important things in a relationship is caring for your significant other through good times and bad.
quotes.author: Nick Cannon

quotes.quote: Life is a series of collisions with the future; it is not the sum of what we have been, but what we yearn to be.
quotes.author: Jose Ortega y Gasset

quotes.quote: With the past, I have nothing to do; nor with the future. I live now.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Let your hopes, not your hurts, shape your future.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: I have a lot of sympathy for young people because I realize how disturbed I was. How would I deal with life in the future? What would I do for a living?
quotes.author: Clyde Tombaugh

quotes.quote: Keep all special thoughts and memories for lifetimes to come. Share these keepsakes with others to inspire hope and build from the past, which can bridge to the future.
quotes.author: Mattie Stepanek

quotes.quote: There are people who are able to plan their career, their future, but I've never had any talent for that. I just do things and hope for the best. Say yes, take a chance, and sometimes it's terrific and sometimes it's not.
quotes.author: Christopher Walken

quotes.quote: I am an enthusiast, but not a crank in the sense that I have some pet theories as to the proper construction of a flying machine. I wish to avail myself of all that is already known and then, if possible, add my mite to help on the future worker who will attain final success.
quotes.author: Wilbur Wright

quotes.quote: As fandom grew more variegated, genzines reflected a broadening of interests, carrying personal columns of humor and reflection, science articles, amateur fiction, stylish gossip, and inevitably, thoughtful pieces on the future of fandom.
quotes.author: Gregory Benford

quotes.quote: With the sugar market hysteria, the people are obviously worried and expect higher inflation. When this hysteria subsides, which we're probably observing, then I hope that people will also get less worried about the future of inflation.
quotes.author: Marek Belka

quotes.quote: Hope makes people good, a lot of the time. You hope for a brighter future, and resentment is outweighed.
quotes.author: Daisy Ridley

quotes.quote: Every great work of art has two faces, one toward its own time and one toward the future, toward eternity.
quotes.author: Lester Bangs

quotes.quote: The essence of optimism is that it takes no account of the present, but it is a source of inspiration, of vitality and hope where others have resigned; it enables a man to hold his head high, to claim the future for himself and not to abandon it to his enemy.
quotes.author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

quotes.quote: I love you. I am who I am because of you. You are every reason, every hope, and every dream I've ever had, and no matter what happens to us in the future, everyday we are together is the greatest day of my life. I will always be yours.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: If ever there is tomorrow when we're not together... there is something you must always remember. You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think. But the most important thing is, even if we're apart... I'll always be with you.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: Creativity is the key to success in the future, and primary education is where teachers can bring creativity in children at that level.
quotes.author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.quote: Everything you need for better future and success has already been written. And guess what? All you have to do is go to the library.
quotes.author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quotes.quote: Some of the best lessons we ever learn are learned from past mistakes. The error of the past is the wisdom and success of the future.
quotes.author: Dale Turner

quotes.quote: Deep in the meadow, hidden far awayA cloak of leaves, a moonbeam rayForget your woes and let your troubles layAnd when it's morning again, they'll wash awayHere it's safe, here it's warmHere the daisies guard you from every harmHere your dreams are sweet and tomorrow brings them trueHere is the place where I love you.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

quotes.quote: The most glorious moments in your life are not the so-called days of success, but rather those days when out of dejection and despair you feel rise in you a challenge to life, and the promise of future accomplishments.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: The youth is the hope of our future.
quotes.author: Jose Rizal

quotes.quote: We must restore hope to young people, help the old, be open to the future, spread love. Be poor among the poor. We need to include the excluded and preach peace.
quotes.author: Pope Francis

quotes.quote: Does art have a future? Performance genres like opera, theater, music and dance are thriving all over the world, but the visual arts have been in slow decline for nearly 40 years. No major figure of profound influence has emerged in painting or sculpture since the waning of Pop Art and the birth of Minimalism in the early 1970s.
quotes.author: Camille Paglia

quotes.quote: Every saint has a past, and every sinner has a future.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: To many, peace is what enables development and is critical in providing opportunities to young people. To some - especially those from regions involved in conflict - peacekeeping and efforts to preserve peace are absolutely vital in bringing prosperity and hope for the future.
quotes.author: Kim Yuna

quotes.quote: Darkness comes. In the middle of it, the future looks blank. The temptation to quit is huge. Don't. You are in good company... You will argue with yourself that there is no way forward. But with God, nothing is impossible. He has more ropes and ladders and tunnels out of pits than you can conceive. Wait. Pray without ceasing. Hope.
quotes.author: John Piper

quotes.quote: Our human compassion binds us the one to the other - not in pity or patronizingly, but as human beings who have learnt how to turn our common suffering into hope for the future.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: I loved my 17 years with R.E.M., but I'm ready to reflect, assess and move on to a different phase of my life. The four of us will continue our close friendship, and I look forward to hearing their future efforts as the world's biggest R.E.M. fan.
quotes.author: Bill Berry

quotes.quote: Encouragement of higher education for our youth is critical to the success of our collective future.
quotes.author: Charles B. Rangel

quotes.quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.quote: I feel friendship towards philosophers, but towards sophists, teachers of literature, or any other such kind of godforsaken people, I neither feel friendship now, nor may I ever do so in the future.
quotes.author: Apollonius of Tyana

quotes.quote: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: You smell good, too,' said PatchIt's called a shower.' I was staring straight ahead. When he didn't answer, I turned sideways. 'Soap. Shampoo. Hot water.'Naked. I know the drill.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: It doesn't give me any satisfaction to think that my concerns will be validated by my grandchildren's generation. I would love to be wrong in everything. My grandchildren are my stake in the near future, and it's my great hope that they might one day say, 'Grandpa was part of a great movement that helped to turn things around.'
quotes.author: David Suzuki

quotes.quote: There are hurdles, there are handicaps, hardships you have to face in life, but you hope for a great future.
quotes.author: Anil Kapoor

quotes.quote: You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards. So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future. You have to trust in something - your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever. This approach has never let me down, and it has made all the difference in my life.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: I have heard there are troubles of more than one kind. Some come from ahead and some come from behind. But I've bought a big bat. I'm all ready you see. Now my troubles are going to have troubles with me!
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Death must be so beautiful. To lie in the soft brown earth, with the grasses waving above one's head, and listen to silence. To have no yesterday, and no tomorrow. To forget time, to forgive life, to be at peace.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Canterville Ghost

quotes.quote: I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: We all have our time machines, don't we. Those that take us back are memories...And those that carry us forward, are dreams.
quotes.author: H.G. Wells

quotes.quote: Why didn't I learn to treat everything like it was the last time. My greatest regret was how much I believed in the future.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

quotes.quote: You practice mindfulness, on the one hand, to be calm and peaceful. On the other hand, as you practice mindfulness and live a life of peace, you inspire hope for a future of peace.
quotes.author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quotes.quote: The past explains how I got here, but the future is up to me - and I love to live life at full throttle.
quotes.author: Janice Dickinson

quotes.quote: Maybe you can afford to wait. Maybe for you there's a tomorrow. Maybe for you there's one thousand tomorrows, or three thousand, or ten, so much time you can bathe in it, roll around it, let it slide like coins through you fingers. So much time you can waste it.But for some of us there's only today. And the truth is, you never really know.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Before I Fall

quotes.quote: The people of Liberia know what it means to be deprived of clean water, but we also know what it means to see our children to begin to smile again with a restoration of hope and faith in the future.
quotes.author: Ellen Johnson Sirleaf

quotes.quote: When you deprive people of their right to live in dignity, to hope for a better future, to have control over their lives, when you deprive them of that choice, then you expect them to fight for these rights.
quotes.author: Queen Rania of Jordan

quotes.quote: There are far, far better things ahead than any we leave behind.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Today a reader, tomorrow a leader.
quotes.author: Margaret Fuller

quotes.quote: The Road goes ever on and onDown from the door where it began.Now far ahead the Road has gone,And I must follow, if I can,Pursuing it with eager feet,Until it joins some larger wayWhere many paths and errands meet.And whither then? I cannot say
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: You realize that our mistrust of the future makes it hard to give up the past.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Survivor

quotes.quote: Worry never robs tomorrow of its sorrow, but only saps today of its strength.
quotes.author: A.J. Cronin

quotes.quote: Pregnancy is something that I always love. It's about hope and the future and a new baby.
quotes.author: Carine Roitfeld

quotes.quote: Never be afraid to trust an unknown future to a known God.
quotes.author: Corrie ten Boom

quotes.quote: Every time you are tempted to react in the same old way, ask if you want to be a prisoner of the past or a pioneer of the future.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Remember if people talk behind your back, it only means you are two steps ahead.
quotes.author: Fannie Flagg,  Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe

quotes.quote: You can't stop the futureYou can't rewind the pastThe only way to learn the secret...is to press play.
quotes.author: Jay Asher,  Thirteen Reasons Why

quotes.quote: Yesterday is gone. Tomorrow has not yet come. We have only today. Let us begin.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: It is sound judgment to hope that in the not too distant future we shall be competent to understand so simple a thing as a star.
quotes.author: Arthur Eddington

quotes.quote: It's amazing how a little tomorrow can make up for a whole lot of yesterday.
quotes.author: John Guare,  Landscape of the Body

quotes.quote: Tact is the ability to tell someone to go to hell in such a way that they look forward to the trip.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: Sometimes, I feel the past and the future pressing so hard on either side that there's no room for the present at all.
quotes.author: Evelyn Waugh,  Brideshead Revisited

quotes.quote: Only you can control your future.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: Poetry is often the art of overhearing yourself say things you didn't know you knew. It is a learned skill to force yourself to articulate your life, your present world or your possibilities for the future.
quotes.author: David Whyte

quotes.quote: The future is now. It's time to grow up and be strong. Tomorrow may well be too late.
quotes.author: Neil LaBute,  Reasons to Be Pretty

quotes.quote: Knowing too much of your future is never a good thing.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

quotes.quote: The future depends on what you do today.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: The past is always tense, the future perfect.
quotes.author: Zadie Smith

quotes.quote: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  On the Road

quotes.quote: Because this is what happens when you try to run from the past. It just doesn't catch up, it overtakes ... blotting out the future.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: Even in the Future the Story Begins with Once Upon a Time.
quotes.author: Marissa Meyer,  Cinder

quotes.quote: Our lives are not our own. We are bound to others, past and present, and by each crime and every kindness, we birth our future.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: Real generosity towards the future lies in giving all to the present.
quotes.author: Albert Camus,  Notebooks 1935-1942

quotes.quote: The greatest danger to our future is apathy.
quotes.author: Jane Goodall

quotes.quote: Tomorrow's life is too late. Live today.
quotes.author: Marcus Valerius Martialis

quotes.quote: Love blurs your vision; but after it recedes, you can see more clearly than ever. It's like the tide going out, revealing whatever's been thrown away and sunk: broken bottles, old gloves, rusting pop cans, nibbled fishbodies, bones. This is the kind of thing you see if you sit in the darkness with open eyes, not knowing the future.
quotes.author: Margaret Atwood,  Cat's Eye

quotes.quote: The secret to getting ahead is getting started.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Solitude is not something you must hope for in the future. Rather, it is a deepening of the present, and unless you look for it in the present you will never find it.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: What were once only hopes for the future have now come to pass; it is almost exactly 13 years since the overwhelming majority of people in Ireland and Northern Ireland voted in favour of the agreement signed on Good Friday 1998, paving the way for Northern Ireland to become the exciting and inspirational place that it is today.
quotes.author: Queen Elizabeth II

quotes.quote: Life is divided into three terms - that which was, which is, and which will be. Let us learn from the past to profit by the present, and from the present, to live better in the future.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth

quotes.quote: Lady Gaga is the present and the future. She is the most revolutionary and inspirational artist. She is fearless and daring.
quotes.author: Donatella Versace

quotes.quote: I hope that in future Congresses there will reemerge a recognition that climate change is a reality, that our policies to meet our energy needs must also deal responsibly with environmental issues, including the damage caused by greenhouse gas emissions.
quotes.author: Jeff Bingaman

quotes.quote: Those who insist on having hostilities with us, kill and destroy the option of friendship with us in the future, which is unfortunate because it is clear the future belongs to Iran and that enmities will be fruitless.
quotes.author: Mahmoud Ahmadinejad

quotes.quote: Listen to the people who love you. Believe that they are worth living for even when you don't believe it. Seek out the memories depression takes away and project them into the future. Be brave; be strong; take your pills. Exercise because it's good for you even if every step weighs a thousand pounds. Eat when food itself disgusts you. Reason with yourself when you have lost your reason.
quotes.author: Andrew Solomon,  The Noonday Demon: An Atlas of Depression

quotes.quote: On every front there are clear answers out there that can make this country stronger, but we're going to break through the fear and the frustration people are feeling. Our job is to make sure that even as we make progress, that we are also giving people a sense of hope and vision for the future.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: We never had books at home, but my dad, seeing how keen I was to read, took me to Islington Library when I was about eight and we pulled out two - a Biggles and a science fiction novel. I never got the ace fighter pilot but fell in love with all things to do with the future and space. Isaac Asimov soon became my guiding star.
quotes.author: Gary Kemp

quotes.quote: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.quote: I know why I am here and my only real focused goal is to live each day to the fullest and to try and honor God and be an encouragement to others. What the future holds is firmly in God's hands, and I am very happy about that!
quotes.author: Ken Hensley

quotes.quote: Once I knew only darkness and stillness... my life was without past or future... but a little word from the fingers of another fell into my hand that clutched at emptiness, and my heart leaped to the rapture of living.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Education is our passport to the future, for tomorrow belongs to the people who prepare for it today.
quotes.author: Malcolm X

quotes.quote: You spend your whole life stuck in the labyrinth, thinking about how you'll escape one day, and how awesome it will be, and imagining that future keeps you going, but you never do it. You just use the future to escape the present.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: I'm choosing happiness over suffering, I know I am. I'm making space for the unknown future to fill up my life with yet-to-come surprises.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

quotes.quote: Drugs are the enemies of ambition and hope - and when we fight against drugs we are fighting for the future.
quotes.author: Bob Riley

quotes.quote: It is by no means an irrational fancy that, in a future existence, we shall look upon what we think our present existence, as a dream.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: Kids are our future, and we hope baseball has given them some idea of what it is to live together and how we can get along, whether you be black or white.
quotes.author: Larry Doby

quotes.quote: I begin my reign with profound emotion at the honour of accepting the Crown, aware of the responsibility it entails and with the greatest hope for the future of Spain.
quotes.author: King Felipe VI

quotes.quote: Everyone here has the sense that right now is one of those moments when we are influencing the future.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: You never change things by fighting the existing reality.To change something, build a new model that makes the existing model obsolete.
quotes.author: R. Buckminster Fuller

quotes.quote: I do write a lot of children's songs, and I'm going to do a children's television show, which also means I'll be doing a lot of albums. So I do hope my future will hold a lot of things for children.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton

quotes.quote: In love, unlike most other passions, the recollection of what you have had and lost is always better than what you can hope for in the future.
quotes.author: Stendhal

quotes.quote: Relax, having kids is years away. But can you imagine? Your brains, my charm, our collective good looks... then add in the usual physical abilities dhampirs get. It's really not even fair to everyone else.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  The Fiery Heart

quotes.quote: People were always getting ready for tomorrow. I didn't believe in that. Tomorrow wasn't getting ready for them. It didn't even know they were there.
quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy,  The Road

quotes.quote: I want to go to sleep in my time machine and wake up eight hours in the future.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future; it is something you design for the present.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: There's a widespread cultural barrenness across art and political culture. But there are some pockets of resistance on the extreme margins, like the techno-savvy protest movements, small press, the creator-owned comics, that seem to be getting some signs of hope for the future.
quotes.author: Alan Moore

quotes.quote: Walk with the dreamers, the believers, the courageous, the cheerful, the planners, the doers, the successful people with their heads in the clouds and their feet on the ground. Let their spirit ignite a fire within you to leave this world better than when you found it...
quotes.author: Wilferd Peterson

quotes.quote: When I saw you, I saw love. When I saw you naked, I saw lust. When I saw you with my clone in a dream, I saw the future.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

quotes.quote: The best way to predict your future is to create it
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Middle class families are struggling to send their sons and daughters to school. For many Americans, a college education is essential to future success.
quotes.author: Albio Sires

quotes.quote: The mind is never satisfied with the objects immediately before it, but is always breaking away from the present moment, and losing itself in schemes of future felicity... The natural flights of the human mind are not from pleasure to pleasure, but from hope to hope.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: But you can build a future out of anything. A scrap, a flicker. The desire to go forward, slowly, one foot at a time. You can build an airy city out of ruins.
quotes.author: Lauren Oliver,  Pandemonium

quotes.quote: Japan's beautiful seas and its territory are under threat, and young people are having trouble finding hope in the future amid economic slump. I promise to protect Japan's land and sea, and the lives of the Japanese people no matter what.
quotes.author: Shinzo Abe

quotes.quote: When you make a choice, you change the future.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: People tell me I look like my father. I've never seen my dad, so does that mean I look invisible?
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If achieving the Hong Kong dream becomes a vanishing hope, then our society will suffer. What would the Hong Kong dream be? It's no different from the American dream, whereby an everyday man on the street who works hard would be able to make good savings and use those savings as equity for their future small business.
quotes.author: Richard Li

quotes.quote: Your fantasies define you, so dream carefully. A man with no imagination is a man with no future in today's world--and no past in tomorrow's.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty: not knowing what comes next.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin,  The Left Hand of Darkness

quotes.quote: Her and I, we passed each other, and now she's in my past. That's one present I'd like to unwrap in the future.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: No, our science is no illusion. But an illusion it would be to suppose that what science cannot give us we can get elsewhere.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud,  The Future of an Illusion

quotes.quote: Microwavable ice cream is the future. Don't wait for love to melt all over your crotch. Scoop some Ice Cream Soup today.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Without libraries what have we? We have no past and no future.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: The life where nothing was ever unexpected. Or inconvenient. Or unusual. The life without colour, pain or past.
quotes.author: Lois Lowry,  The Giver

quotes.quote: The Fourteenth Book is entitled, "What can a Thoughtful Man Hope for Mankind on Earth, Given the Experience of the Past Million Years?"It doesn't take long to read The Fourteenth Book. It consists of one word and a period. This is it: "Nothing.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Cat's Cradle

quotes.quote: Silver is an investment. It's like a second-place future. Makes me want to create Michael Phelps-flavored ice cream and eat a whole tub.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: And we want to develop our strategy to partnership and friendship with the United States, which is connected with a very rich history but what is very important for our future.
quotes.author: Aleksander Kwasniewski

quotes.quote: Human relationships always help us to carry on because they always presuppose further developments, a future - and also because we live as if our only task was precisely to have relationships with other people.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Its more fun to think of the future than dwell on the past.
quotes.author: Sara Shepard,  Unbelievable

quotes.quote: Rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling

quotes.quote: The past is made out of facts... I guess the future is just hope.
quotes.author: Isaac Marion,  Warm Bodies

quotes.quote: in a woman's womb.another chance.to make the world better.
quotes.author: Ellen Hopkins,  Burned

quotes.quote: You are always free to change your mind and choose a different future, or a different past.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: Only a fool tells people that only fools buy gold. In the coming future, I'd rather have fool's gold than dollar bills. Ask Zimbabwe.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I see two women, one in a reflection in a window, and the other I see through the window, and it's like I'm looking at both my past and future at the same time.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Just what future the Designer of the universe has provided for the souls of men I do not know, I cannot prove. But I find that the whole order of Nature confirms my confidence that, if it is not like our noblest hopes and dreams, it will transcend them.
quotes.author: Henry Norris Russell

quotes.quote: She's twelve hours in the future, and exactly half a world away. No matter how hard I try, I will always be a part of her past.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: My past is black and my future is blank. My only canvas is the present. The best color to paint with is love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: You have within you,right now,everything you need to deal with whatever the world can throw at you.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: When someone you love says goodbye you can stare long and hard at the door they closed and forget to see all the doors God has open in front of you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: When I think about the kind of guy I want to marry, I think I might prefer someone who knows where they are going. I mean a prince pretty much has his whole life planned out already, doesn't he? And this is important because I have no idea where I'm going or what I want to do with my life.
quotes.author: Jillian Dodd,  That Boy

quotes.quote: Whoever said that the past isn't dead had it backward. It's the future that's already dead, already played out.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  Where She Went

quotes.quote: When I lost her I gained the future, because she was my past, and she freed me to become who I was born to be.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The sunset sky fades from blue to orange over Gainesville, Florida, and what I lost is less than what I gained. I gained love, I lost love, and if could do it all again, I would.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: People who say that yesterday was better than today are ultimately devaluing their own existence.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: The future was one thing that could never be broken, because it had not yet had the chance to be anything.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Saint Anything

quotes.quote: Inherited Will, The Destiny of the Age, and The Dreams of the People. As long as people continue to pursue the meaning of Freedom, these things will never cease to be!"- Gol D. Roger
quotes.author: Eiichiro Oda
